question: What is the minimum copper wire gauge for a standard 20-amp branch circuit in a home?
true_claim_text: a 20-amp circuit requires 12 AWG copper at minimum
false_claim_text: 14 AWG copper is fine on a 20-amp circuit
source: National Electrical Code 240.4(D): 14 AWG copper is limited to 15-amp overcurrent protection; a 20-amp branch circuit requires 12 AWG copper minimum. Undersized wire on a 20 A breaker is a fire hazard.
